citations.claim: The component uses React 19, Vocs framework, and Wrangler for Cloudflare deployment
The site is configured for static generation with dark theme and SEO optimization
Documentation is organized into Start, Operate, Extend Centaur, Secrets, and Reference sections
Open Graph images are pre-generated at build time using SVG templates and custom fonts
MDX pages are copied to public/md/ as plain markdown for agent consumption
Interactive React components showcase real Slack conversation examples
Site deploys to centaur.run domain via Cloudflare Workers
Landing page uses custom layout with hero section and disabled sidebar
Documentation explains Centaur as a control plane for shared AI agents
Global styling uses CSS custom properties for theming and brand colors
Open Graph images are generated with path-based slug mapping
Brand menu provides downloads and GitHub access via right-click on logo
Google Fonts are loaded dynamically for Open Graph image generation
Build process generates PNG cards for each route with fallback handling
Build pipeline includes markdown copying, brand bundling, and OG generation
